playstyle: Own the far half of the field. Set a zone, stay out of the brawl, and let the cannon do the work. Every shot roots you and shoves you back, so choose your ground before you shoot.

abilities.name: Claw Strike
effects: stagger 0.4 s
uses the free claw hand, never the cannon arm
abilities.notes: The hand that is still a hand. Weak, but it never roots the Gunner and never breaks a cloak.

abilities.name: Arc Cannon
effects: roots the Gunner for 0.6 s while the cannon cycles
0.4 s muzzle trace: a glowing line from the muzzle to the aim point, and the shell lands at the end of it
recoil pushes the Gunner 1.5 m back along the aim
the shot is a 30 degree cone at 20.0 m
abilities.notes: Root-and-charge: 20.0 m of reach, a 30 degree cone, 0.4 s of trace as the only warning, and 1.5 m of recoil. Firing breaks the cloak.

abilities.name: Recoil Step
effects: cancels the root of the current cannon charge
moves the Gunner 3.0 m back along the aim
leaves the 0.4 s muzzle trace behind, unchanged
abilities.notes: The answer to a root-and-charge weapon: 6.0 s cooldown, no cost, 3.0 m of free space.

abilities.name: Cluster Shell
effects: lobs a shell 12.0 m that bursts in a 3.5 m circle
stagger 1.0 s
knocks back 2.0 m
the knockback breaks every bind and tether on the affected targets
leaves burning ground for 3.0 s that deals 10 damage per second
abilities.notes: The arc lobs over cover. 0.5 s cast, and the ground circle shows where it will land. Firing breaks the cloak.

abilities.name: Ash Cloak
effects: for 10.0 s the Gunner is hidden from enemies more than 8.0 m away
the cloak breaks the moment the Gunner fires any cannon ability: Arc Cannon, Cluster Shell, Anchor Shot, Barrage or Siege Stance
the cloak also breaks if the Gunner takes more than 60 damage in one hit
movement speed -10% while cloaked
abilities.notes: The cloak and the cannon cannot live together: firing breaks it, taking a big hit breaks it. Plan the shot first, cloak second.

abilities.name: Smoke Bloom
effects: a 5.0 m smoke cloud for 8.0 s at 8.0 m
enemies inside the cloud cannot see past 3.0 m
the cloud blocks cannon sight lines for both sides
abilities.notes: Vision denial for the whole team, not a personal cloak. It also blinds the Gunner, so do not shoot into it.

abilities.name: Barrage
effects: marks a 6.0 m circle at 25.0 m
6 shells land over 3.0 s, one every 0.5 s
each shell deals 45 damage in a 3.0 m circle
the first shell lands 1.0 s after the cast, so the circle is visible for 1.0 s
abilities.notes: The zone: one circle, six shells, one visible timer. It does not move and it does not chase. Firing breaks the cloak.

abilities.name: Aim True
effects: for 8.0 s the next cannon shot deals 50% more damage
that shot pierces one extra target in the cone
the muzzle trace turns from orange to white while it runs
abilities.notes: The artillery button: 25.0 s cooldown, 10 mana, and it only changes the next shot.

abilities.name: Anchor Shot
effects: fires a barbed line at 22.0 m
roots the first target it hits for 2.0 s
pulls the Gunner to that target over 1.0 s
the pull breaks on any knockback
abilities.notes: A hook, not a shot: it ends with the enemy in cannon range. A knockback beats it, so watch for Cinder Burst.

abilities.name: Ground Pulse
effects: a 15.0 m pulse around the Gunner
every hidden enemy inside is revealed to the whole Ashkin faction for 12.0 s
the reveal is a faction-wide mark, not a personal one: every Ashkin sees the hidden enemy
cancels stealth effects on the ground inside the pulse: cloaks, shadow steps and smoke walls
abilities.notes: The whole faction sees what the pulse finds, not just the Gunner. 15.0 m radius, 12.0 s of reveal, 30.0 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Siege Stance
effects: for 15.0 s the arm cannon fires every 1.2 s without a cooldown
each shot roots the Gunner for 0.5 s and adds 1.0 m of recoil
cannon damage is 30% higher
the Gunner cannot move while the stance runs
abilities.notes: Artillery mode: 15.0 s, 45 mana, 120.0 s cooldown. The recoil stacks, so after 6 shots the Gunner has been pushed 6.0 m back and must be pulled off the line.

weakness: Close range. Every shot roots the Gunner for 0.6 s and pushes him 1.5 m back, so a fast melee reaches him between shots and the recoil walks him into the enemy line. Smoke Bloom blocks his own sight lines too: the Gunner can break a sight line he was counting on.
